scope: Ask before decoding a project that would replace unsaved GUI work, and report a declined replacement as cancelled. Existing MCP project import already requires replace:true before decoding.
before: The browser test declined the replacement prompt after observing a new project-decoding worker; it failed with worker count 4 versus 3. The guarded run closed all owned processes.

after.browserAndPublicMcp: Passed. GUI decline reports Import cancelled with zero completed files, does not start a decoder, and preserves project revision and objects. Public MCP project_import with replace:false fails before starting a decoder and preserves revision and objects. A subsequent GUI and MCP import of the same valid binary fixture succeeds, including exact normal-byte checks.
after.build: All 15 TypeScript batches, production bundle and offline manifest passed.

originalPly3ConfirmedReplacement.result: Passed GUI Split/Extract, project export, complete public MCP download, early replacement confirmation, GUI reopen, geometry comparison and post-reopen GUI Undo/Redo.

limitations: This avoids decoding when replacement is declined; it does not reduce peak memory for a confirmed restore or resolve numeric-array ownership.
The native comparison and remaining M2 resource, integration and closure gates remain open.
